messages.text: For a Aerospace / Defense use case involving radar, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

The passages identify the CMX500 as a radio communication / network emulation and measurement tester for LTE, 5G NR, WLAN, signaling, non-signaling verification, RF, application and mobility testing [8][10][2][5].
By contrast, the radar-specific workflow is represented by the AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator, which generates dynamic artificial radar objects / echoes for a radar under test, including FMCW radar cases [35][40].
For an Aerospace / Defense context, the supported CMX500-related fit is around **private/tactical 5G communications resilience**, not radar target simulation: the A&D resilience material discusses unmodified 5G DUT connections under smart jamming, mapping to 5G handover and frequency-hopping signaling, and notes CMX500 as a network emulator in that test context [28][24][29].
Therefore, it would be used to test the communications link, network behavior, RF/signaling/non-signaling behavior, mobility, throughput, or resilience of connected systems around the radar asset, while the radar workflow itself would use radar echo-generation equipment for target/object simulation [8][2][5][35].
| Workflow area | Equipment role | Supported fit |
|---|---|---|
| Radar sensor / radar-under-test workflow | Primary radar test equipment | AREG800A generates dynamic artificial objects / echoes for radar under test and FMCW radar scenarios [35][40]. |
| Communications / connectivity around the radar system | Adjacent Signaling / Non-signaling Tester | CMX500 provides network emulation and measurement for LTE, NR FR1/FR2, WLAN, signaling, measurements, application testing, and non-signaling verification [8][10][2]. |
| A&D contested-network / smart-jamming workflow | Adjacent tactical/private-5G testbed element | The A&D resilience use case concerns unmodified 5G DUT connections under smart jamming and maps the test problem to 5G handover / frequency-hopping signaling; CMX500 is identified as a network emulator in that context [28][24][29]. |
【推論】If the A&D radar system also depends on 5G/WLAN/LTE connectivity for command, control, data transport, or system integration, the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester would be placed after or alongside radar sensor validation to verify the communications layer, while radar echo generation remains the primary radar test function [8][35].

passages.text:
CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › UI 與 automation
來源將 [[CMsquares]] 描述為 web based、all-in-one configuration、all tools in one place、modern UI，並列出：

- live views。
- App Testing。
- NTN live views。
- Sequencer。
- Log analysis。
- One-click RF testing。

在 RF pre-conformance 脈絡中，來源稱可 quick switch from manual to automated pre-conformance，且使用 same technology specific license，並指向 [[CMX500 Sequencer Test Packages]] 與 `Sequencer-CMX-Test_Packages_Database.xlsx`。

CMX500 Callbox › Application / mobility use cases
來源列出的 callbox application / mobility use cases 包含：

- [[Mobility Testing]]。
- [[Network Slicing]]。
- [[IP Throughput]]。
- [[Security Analysis]]。
- [[Backend Service]]。
- [[IMS Services]]。
- [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]。
- [[ATSSS]]。
- [[Power Consumption]]。
- [[XR Responsiveness & L4S]]。
- [[eCall]] / [[NGeCall]]。
- [[Speech Quality]]。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

CMX500 Callbox › unresolved
- 來源未標示簡報版本、作者、正式發佈日期與對應 CSW software release。
- 多個 use cases 未列出完整 option stack、BOM、DUT 條件或測試報告。
- Roadmap 字樣如 coming soon、coming in 2025 and later、planned for CSW 9.00 / 9.10 需以 release note 或正式 product documentation 補證。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › 使用介面與 automation
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

| 介面 | 原文定位 |
|---|---|
| [[CMsquares]] | 單一 graphical user interface，web-based、responsive，支援 RF tests、functional tests、advanced signaling tests、protocol tests |
| [[R&S CMXmars]] | Message log analysis，可離線分析或在線監控 instrument messaging |
| [[R&S CMsequencer]] | Graphical scripting interface，可在 CMX500 或 Windows PC 上建立、設定與執行 test scripts |
| [[XLAPI]] | Python-based scripting interface，適合 complex scripting use cases |
| [[SCPI]] | Remote control interface，適合 simple、standardized scripting use cases |

XLAPI scripting environment：Python 3.10；script development computer 可為 Windows PC 或 CMX500；XLAPI installation package 為 **CMX-KF600X**。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › Rear panel interfaces
- LAN：Ethernet RJ-45 connector，1000 Mbps。
- Trigger interfaces：Trig. A、Trig. B，2 × BNC connector，3.3 V TTL；Trig. C、Trig. D、Trig. E，3 × BNC connector，3.3 V TTL；AST Out，1 × BNC connector。
- Flexx Sync interface：for future use；In 為 1 × mini SAS HD connector；Loop 為 2 × mini SAS HD connector；Out 為 1 × mini SAS HD connector。
- Flexx Data interface：for future use；In/Out 各 1 × QSFP-DD connector。
- Flexx IQ interface：for future use；In/Out 各 1 × QSFP-DD connector。
- LAN Switch Subnet Only interface：for future use；port 1、port 2 各 1 × SFP+ connector。
- USB：for keyboard、mouse、USB flash drive；2 × USB 3.1 type A connector。
- HDMI：for external monitor；DisplayPort：for external monitor。

R&S CMX500 › R&S CMX-B300C processing unit
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX-B300C]] 需要 [[R&S CMX-PB70H]] option，提供 generic high-performance computing platform for advanced data processing。Interfaces：

| LAN DAU | CMX500 subnet only；QSFP+；1 Gbps、10 Gbps、40 Gbps |
| Internal use LAN | CMX500 subnet only；Ethernet RJ-45；1 Gbps |
| USB DAU | for future use |

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 技術映射
來源將 resilience 問題映射到兩類 5G / FH 行為：

1. Mapping to [[5G Handover]] signaling。
2. Mapping to 5G frequency-hopping signaling / legacy [[FHSS]] capabilities。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 將此具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：使用 [[5G Handover]] 在多個 cells / carrier frequencies 之間切換，使 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change。來源說 prerequisite 是 highly reliable inter-frequency handovers，以便在 constantly changing carrier frequency 時仍維持 dependable communications link。

依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- 5G NR UE 上市前需要通過符合 [[3GPP]] specifications 的 device certification。
- [[RF pre-conformance testing]] 又稱 design verification。
- RF pre-conformance testing 應在產品開發早期開始，用於及早找出並處理問題，減少延遲並提升最終產品品質。

- Test case procedures 針對 R&D use cases 最佳化，使用 specification 中最相關的 configurations。

RF pre-conformance testing › 與 strict conformance testing 的差異
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]：

- Application note procedures 可能相較 [[3GPP]] specification 更 streamlined 或 simplified。
- Pre-conformance testing 目標是在基於 [[3GPP]] specification 的 streamlined procedure 中提供 meaningful results，但不嚴格遵循所有 parameters。
- 嚴格的 RF conformance testing 與 validated test cases 可使用 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。

因此本概念頁不可把 [[R&S CMX500]] WebGUI pre-conformance workflow 等同正式 certification lab 或 validated conformance test cases。

5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance testing › WebGUI workflow 摘要
典型流程包含：

1. 補償 signal path attenuation。
2. 在 Frequency Dependent Attenuation tab 定義 attenuation tables。
3. 在 RF Connections tab 將 attenuation tables / fixed values 連結到特定 [[RF path]]。
4. 開啟 3GPP Pre-conformance testing workspace。
5. 在 configuration sidebar 設定 band 與 frequency settings。
6. 啟動 network emulation 並使 cell Go Live。
7. 確認 [[DUT]] 已連接。
8. 選擇 test case 與 Test ID。
9. Test ID 依 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] tables 設定 RB allocation 與 modulation scheme。
10. 點擊 Apply 執行 test case。

[[CMX500_Callbox]] 以簡報方式補充此 workflow 的 sales wording：3GPP Pre-Conformance Wizard takes care of 3GPP RMC settings，並可在 GUI 中 quick and easy 進行 3GPP pre-conformance testing。

5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance testing › Test ID 與 UE capability 限制
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]：

- Test cases 不會處理 UE capabilities，使用者需自行注意各自 UE capabilities。
- 選擇 test case 不會覆寫使用者設定的 signaling parameters。
- 部分 Test IDs 只針對特定 frequency + bandwidth combination；不適用時，CMX 會在 UL scheduling 顯示 not applicable，並在 event log 顯示 warning。
- 在不適用情況下套用 settings，會回復為 generic default configuration。
- PUCCH subtests 的 UL parameters 可能顯示 not applicable，因 GUI 只顯示 PUSCH scheduling；PUCCH configuration 仍依 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] 套用。
- PUCCH subtests 建議關閉 UE data；UE 對 UL resources 的每次 scheduling request 都會導致 call drops，因沒有 PUSCH resources 可用。

2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient › 重點摘要
這份來源是由 [[Randy Schnell]] 製作 / 主講的 company restricted 簡報，題為 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient；raw frontmatter 顯示原檔為 `2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`，轉檔日期為 2026-09-17。來源正文沒有另外標示正式發布日期；本頁以檔名 / raw title 的 2025-12-19 作為來源日期線索。

簡報主張的核心問題是：在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下，能否利用 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] 能力，讓 unmodified 5G DUT connection 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具韌性。

主要內容如下：

- 任務背景：tactical edge connectivity 對資料與低延遲需求提高，[[Smart Jamming]] 與 electronic warfare（[[EW]]）威脅增加，private [[5G]] networks 在 military bases / tactical environments 的採用升高。

- 測試結果：來源聲稱 both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；throughput 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 支撐 video-call reliability 維持，但投影片 OCR 未提供具體 throughput、jitter、packet loss、bandwidth、jammer profile 或 modem 型號數值。
- 現有 defense / Future-G program 脈絡：來源列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]]、[[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing 等項目，說明 FHSS / frequency-agile operation 與 5G / 6G coexistence 的整合方向。
- 時程展望：來源給出 short term 2025–2028、mid term 2028–2032、long term 2032–2035+ 三段式展望，包含 5G tactical networks scale-out、mmWave phased arrays field testing、5G/6G-capable SD radios、early ISAC for drone detection / perimeter defense、URLLC for autonomy、full 6G with integrated sensing、AI-native battlefield connectivity 與 spectrum-aware autonomy。
- Call to action：重新接觸既有 CMX customers，尤其 DOW customers；與 integrators 溝通；保持 tactical patience；提早 engage BDM organization；跨團隊分享 lessons learned。

The passages identify the CMX500 as a radio communication / network emulation and measurement tester for LTE, 5G NR, WLAN, signaling, non-signaling verification, RF, application and mobility testing [8][10][2][5].
By contrast, the radar-specific workflow is represented by the AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator, which generates dynamic artificial radar objects / echoes for a radar under test, including FMCW radar cases [35][40].
For an Aerospace / Defense context, the supported CMX500-related fit is around **private/tactical 5G communications resilience**, not radar target simulation: the A&D resilience material discusses unmodified 5G DUT connections under smart jamming, mapping to 5G handover and frequency-hopping signaling, and notes CMX500 as a network emulator in that test context [28][24][29].
Therefore, it would be used to test the communications link, network behavior, RF/signaling/non-signaling behavior, mobility, throughput, or resilience of connected systems around the radar asset, while the radar workflow itself would use radar echo-generation equipment for target/object simulation [8][2][5][35].
| Workflow area | Equipment role | Supported fit |
|---|---|---|
| Radar sensor / radar-under-test workflow | Primary radar test equipment | AREG800A generates dynamic artificial objects / echoes for radar under test and FMCW radar scenarios [35][40]. |
| Communications / connectivity around the radar system | Adjacent Signaling / Non-signaling Tester | CMX500 provides network emulation and measurement for LTE, NR FR1/FR2, WLAN, signaling, measurements, application testing, and non-signaling verification [8][10][2]. |
| A&D contested-network / smart-jamming workflow | Adjacent tactical/private-5G testbed element | The A&D resilience use case concerns unmodified 5G DUT connections under smart jamming and maps the test problem to 5G handover / frequency-hopping signaling; CMX500 is identified as a network emulator in that context [28][24][29]. |
【推論】If the A&D radar system also depends on 5G/WLAN/LTE connectivity for command, control, data transport, or system integration, the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester would be placed after or alongside radar sensor validation to verify the communications layer, while radar echo generation remains the primary radar test function [8][35].

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 技術映射
來源將 resilience 問題映射到兩類 5G / FH 行為：

1. Mapping to [[5G Handover]] signaling。
2. Mapping to 5G frequency-hopping signaling / legacy [[FHSS]] capabilities。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 將此具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：使用 [[5G Handover]] 在多個 cells / carrier frequencies 之間切換，使 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change。來源說 prerequisite 是 highly reliable inter-frequency handovers，以便在 constantly changing carrier frequency 時仍維持 dependable communications link。
